title: Experience is field-integrated information felt from inside

statements.text: Consciousness is what physically integrated information feels like from the frame of the photons that encode it. A quale such as hearing middle C is what the field perturbation correlated with that input feels like from the inside.

sources.quote: Consciousness is what physically integrated information feels like, from the frame of the photons encoding that information.
is what an a EM field perturbation in the brain that correlates with the sensory input of middle C feels like, from the inside
